profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Intuit.
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Nodejs, Expressjs, JavaScript, PWA, BigQuery, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Identity Platform. Strong engineering professional with a Master's degree focused in Computer Science from University at Albany, SUNY.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
National Cancer Institute (Contractor)
· Designed and implemented first of its kind next-generation cohort study for Cancer Prevention using GCP managed services which led to 100 fold reduction in cost and time spent on the operations.
· Implemented stateless REST API ecosystem using Cloud Functions and Cloud Firestore as a no-SQL database which led to better availability and scalability.
· Improved user experience by developing a Progressive Web Application resulted in better user engagement and retention.
· Reduced the amount of effort required for user sign-up by utilizing Cloud Identity Platform for Password-less and Sign in with Phone which led to improvement in enrollment.
· Federated authentication and authorization of the Admin Dashboard using SAML and Active Directories which led to robust access management.
· Developed a zero-idle, highly scalable, and customizable notification system to improve user engagement using Twilio / SendGrid.
· Improved the ability to effectively analyze data by implementing a process that automatically transfers no-SQL data to BigQuery.
· Designed and implemented a workflow that efficiently integrates and deploys applications on different tiers using Cloud Build.
· Designed and implemented a zero-footprint Data Platform which facilitated different Cancer Studies to collaborate across the U.S and European countries while staying compliant with GDPR using BOX.com.
· Implemented a search engine for Genomics Data Common Metadata Validation System using elastic search which drastically improved performance and accuracy of search results.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- working on Idea Thread Mapper - 3, a National Science Foundation - cyber learning grant project (child project of Kf6).
- fetching the data using JQuery Ajax method.
- responsible for the representation of notes written by students using plotly.js library.
- responsible for data analysis and UI/UX development.
- representing the over all project view with the help of d3js collapsible tree.
- tracking the note view record and showing the notes which are read using red circle.
- allowing student to highlight content of the notes.
- allowing students to customize the look and feel of the collapsible tree by allowing them to select their own colors for different topics.

certifications.name: Introduction to TensorFlow for Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning
certifications.title: Introduction to TensorFlow for Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning

projects.title: EMPLOYEE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
projects.description: It’s a Java MVC based web system, which provides managers to create any number of directories and can restrict the access of those directories, there can be any level of manager - employee hierarchy, manager can also assign bonus to his/her immediate employees, he/she can manage leave request. Admin can assign Manager to newly registered employee, Admin is also responsible to run payroll. Employee can request leave, view/upload files to all the directories if he/she has directory access.

projects.title: Idea Thread Mapper 3
projects.description: Idea Thread Mapper (ITM) is a research-based collaborative platform for students to conduct deep inquiry and sustained knowledge building. Its features support student collaboration within each classroom and cross communities. Responsible for the representation of notes, cross project notes, weighted tree of projects, wondering areas and topics in a project using d3 visualization.
